basis: GTAP 12 ch.7 s7.3: IMF ICSD to 2019, then GTAP's own perpetual-inventory estimates for the reference year; the text does not name the revaluation index. A current-cost stock is the constant-price stock times the price of the assets; ICSD's own current-price stocks (kgov_n, kpriv_n) equal the constant-price stocks times the investment price (k_n / k_rppp = i_n / i_rppp in every year), so the roll-forward from ICSD revalues with the implicit GFCF deflator (WDI NE.GDI.FTOT.CN / NE.GDI.FTOT.KD). The GDP deflator is used where the country has no constant-price GFCF or its GFCF comes from a configured official source (config/s02/capital_roll_sources.csv). Switch back with value gdp_deflator (the rule before this round).

decided_by: David (2026-10-27 08:39 UTC, beta v5 package v2 approved as recommended: item Y); rate test for South Sudan: David 2026-10-27 09:32 UTC ("I'm happy with both of those fixes", real-terms audit)
basis: Beta v5 Y (round-3 oddities item 7; trace s16/betav5/traces/gold_routes_yemen.md section 3). WDI has no 2022 GDP for Yemen, so S02 took UN AMA: 6.42 bn USD, 168 USD per head, the lowest in the world. The AMA national-currency series for Yemen rises by the same 139.5 bn rial every year 2020-2024 (a UN straight-line imputation with no inflation, while rial prices rose 20-40% a year) and is converted at the Aden market rate (about 1,115 YER/USD). Rule: a country whose GDP comes from UN AMA takes IMF WEO current-USD GDP for the base year (data/imf_weo, WEO October 2026) when the AMA national-currency GDP rises by equal steps over the last 5 years of the file (range of increments under 0.1% of their mean) or AMA GDP per head is below 250 USD, and WEO has a value. C, G and GFCF keep their AMA shares of AMA GDP times the WEO GDP. On the 2026-10-20 AMA file only Yemen meets either test (of 9 AMA-GDP countries: AIA COK CUB ERI MSR PRK SSD VGB YEM); PRK (AMA 15.2 bn, 592 USD per head, not imputed) has no WEO value and stays at AMA. The WEO October 2026 edition (the value is for 2022) has a Yemen total of 11.107 bn USD with 645.8 USD per head, which implies 17.2 m people against WDI's 38.22 m, so the total likely covers only part of the country; the value used is set by weo_gdp_basis (per head x S02 population, 24.68 bn, an estimate). Checks S02-Rweo (report) and S02-Hweo (hard); ledger rule GDP-WEO. GTAP 12 ch.7 pp.1-2 takes GDP from WDI, then UN sources, and states no plausibility rule, so the tests and WEO as a third source are a labelled departure. Alternatives: off (AMA as published); AMA rial GDP at the Sana'a rate (about 12.8 bn, trace). Value updated 2026-10-27 09:32 UTC (real-terms audit s16/betav5/real_terms_audit/REPORT.md, action 2): a third test, the AMA exchange rate (AMA national-currency GDP over AMA USD GDP) more than 1.5x off the WDI official rate PA.NUS.FCRF in either direction. It catches SSD only (AMA about 2,139 SSP per USD, near the parallel rate; WDI 534.5; WEO 536): GDP 4.36 -> 7.53 bn USD, C, G, GFCF at AMA shares. ERI (15.075 both) and YEM (1,115 both) pass the rate test; CUB has no WDI rate (handled by gdp_lcu_official_rate). The previous value (no rate test) stays as an alternative.
